findings.current: the predator that ruled this stretch of forest
findings.defect: “Forest” specifies a setting that the Korean does not establish; 이 근방 means this vicinity or area.
findings.rationale: The source identifies the leopard as the predator ruling this area, without specifying that it is a forest. The accepted baseline also says “this area.”
findings.replacement: the predator that ruled this area

summary: The translation is broadly faithful. One minor added setting detail goes beyond the Korean source.
